title: EARTH UPPER ATMOSPHERE FORECAST TOOL FOR MISSION DESIGN AND OPERATIONS EXPRO+
description: Objective: To develop a software for VLEO atmospheric environment models that could reduce mission design margins and risks of satellite loss by non-compensated atmospheric drag effects at low altitudes.Description: Atmospheric density increase during geomagnetically active periods is a well know phenomenon. However, the increase of atmospheric density is not well-constrained and predictableand becomes particularly troublesome for the early phases of spacecraft commissioning that rely on a very low altitude (e.g. 200 to300 km) initial orbit. To date, for general spacecraft design purposes, the ESA Space Environment Information System (SPENVIS) includes various Earth atmosphere and wind models, some of which also consider geomagnetic activity. Several upper-atmosphere co-exist butthere are no comprehensive model or database of atmospheric and thermospheric parameters allowing to capture intra- (local time, seasonal, solar and magnetospheric inputs-driven) and inter-model variabilities, in order to derive better informed engineering margins. In such context, the proposed activity aims to fill that gap by developing a software allowing to interrogate models and definevariability envelopes based on major variability drivers (e.g. solar events, seasonal effects etc.) useful for design and exploitationphases. Software outputs shall feed the existing Space Weather modelling network with relevant products. In addition, the activity will establish a method to build model-based, time-dependent, 3D atmospheric parameter snapshots in order to produce a database of relevant parameters (at least species densities, temperatures as a function of altitude), including variabilities over different timescales relevant to mission design and planning (e.g. daily to seasonal) as a function of local time and latitude. This activity encompasses the following tasks: - Review the existing state of the art models of the upper atmosphere, including preferably couplingeffects between the thermosphere / ionosphere system and solar inputs, as well as state of the art (e.g. ML based) methods allowingto capture atmospheric variability and temporal evolution as a function of external forcing (e.g. solar activity). - Define LEO/VLEO user and software requirements definition, including interfacing with relevant Space Weather tools and databases, and the capability toevolve as updated models and data become available. - Concept design, and a preliminary architecture design. - Develop and test critical functions to validate the approach. - Consolidate the design, full implementation and testing of the software. - Validatethe software by using independent data where possible and inter-models comparisons.Procurement Policy: C(1) = Activity restricted to non-prime contractors (incl. SMEs). title: Radôme station télémesure des Bermudes
description:
The French Guyana Space Center telemetry station located on the Bermuda archipelago is often operated during the CSG launch campaigns. Installed in the Bermuda in 2011 this station is exposed to a hostile environment; high temperatures, tropical storms, high level of air salinity. These elements strongly affect the antenna mechanics and fluids. They lead to a premature drying and corrosion that can damage the system. The installation of a dome is necessary as a countermeasure to protect the whole antenna from its external environment. 
La station de télémesure du Centre Spatial Guyanais localisée aux Bermudes est régulièrement utilisée pour le suivi des campagnes de lancements depuis le site du Centre Spatial Guyanais. Installée aux Bermudes en 2011, l’antenne est soumise à l’environnement de l’archipel qui présente une climatologie éprouvante pour les éléments mécaniques et fluides par des températures élevées, des tempêtes tropicales, une salinité de l’air importante. Ces conditions impactent fortement les différents éléments de l’antenne et provoquent un assèchement et une corrosion prématurés de ces derniers. Afin de protéger l’ensemble de l’antenne de son environnement extérieur, la mise en place d’un radôme s’avère nécessaire.

title: Testiranje možnosti in izvedba kartiranja traviščnih habitatnih tipov z daljinskim zaznavanjem s poudarkom na satelitskih posnetkih visoke ločljivosti
description: Namen tega javnega naročila je nadaljevati z razvojem in testiranjem možnosti razlikovanja med habitatnimi tipi ekstenzivnih travišč na manjših, homogenih predelih Slovenije. Cilj je proučiti možnosti, ki jih nudi daljinsko zaznavanje za ugotavljanje in spremljanje stanja ekstenzivnih traviščnih habitatnih tipov in izvedbo kartiranja z daljinskim zaznavanjem predvsem za večja travniška območja Natura 2000, kjer je uporaba metode terenskega kartiranja težko izvedljiva v dovolj pogostih intervalih. Testiranje možnosti in izvedba kartiranja traviščnih habitatnih tipov z daljinskim zaznavanjem s poudarkom na satelitskih posnetkih visoke ločljivosti: Z javnim naročilom želimo izboljšati znanje, metode in podatke potrebne za uspešno upravljanje travišč v območjih Natura 2000 in preko tega prispevati k blaženju podnebnih sprememb z ohranjanjem raznolikih in odpornih ekosistemov in z ogljikom bogatih tal. K temu sodi tudi preizkušanje in razvoj novih pristopov k zaznavanju in spremljanju stanja, ki bodo omogočali izvajanje učinkovitega in uspešnega, hkrati pa tudi gospodarnega pridobivanja podatkov za ohranjanje in upravljanje ekstenzivnih traviščnih habitatnih tipov. Predmet javnega naročila je testiranje možnosti in omejena izvedba kartiranja ekstenzivnih traviščnih habitatnih tipov z daljinskim zaznavanjem s poudarkom na testiranju uporabe satelitskih posnetkov visoke ločljivosti. Cilj je proučiti možnosti, ki jih nudi daljinsko zaznavanje za ugotavljanje in spremljanje stanja ekstenzivnih traviščnih habitatnih tipov in izvedbo kartiranja z daljinskim zaznavanjem predvsem za večja travniška območja Natura 2000, kjer je uporaba metode terenskega kartiranja težko izvedljiva v dovolj pogostih intervalih.

description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.06.2025 in Kraft und endet am 31.05.2027 (zzgl. Verlängerungsoption 1x12 Monate). description: Radovi održavanja javnih cesta ustupaju se pravnoj ili fizičkoj osobi koja je za te radove registrirana, specijalizirana, tehnički opremljena i kadrovski osposobljena za izvođenje radova održavanja pod prometom. (čl. 33. Zakona o cestama, 84/11, 22/13, 54/13, 148/13, 92/14, 110/19, 144/21, 114/22, 114/22, 04/23, 133/23). Redovito održavanje i zaštita Ž i L cesta izvodi se sukladno Okvirnom troškovniku koji sadrži popis i opis radova i koji je sastavni dio ove Dokumentacije o nabavi, sukladno Zakonu o cestama, Pravilniku o održavanju cesta (NN 90/14, 3/21) i Zakonu o gradnji kao i pravilima struke, te ostalim zakonima i propisima koji se odnose na predmetne radove i ophodnju. Nakon završenog otvorenog postupka javne nabave, Naručitelj će s jednim najbolje ocijenjenim gospodarskim subjektom sklopiti Okvirni sporazum. Redovito održavanje čine radovi koji su opisani u Okvirnom Troškovniku koji je sastavni dio ove Dokumentacije o nabavi. Temeljem „Izvedbenog programa radova zimske službe na održavanju županijskih i lokalnih cesta tijekom izvršavanja zimske službe ugovorni izvoditelj radova (GS) kao i njegovi podugovaratelji obvezni su omogućiti pregled rada vozila zimske službe putem GPS sustava nadzora vozila. title: Ireland – Laboratory services – 26-007F National Multi-Supplier Framework for the Provision of Laboratory Services
description: Uisce Eireann is seeking to establish a high-quality sampling and or analysis service to achieve efficiencies in all commercial laboratory contractual arrangements, to meet regulatory requirements, and to protect public health. These services will be sub-divided into Three (3) Lots described below as Lot 1, Lot 2 and Lot 3. Applicants may apply for one, some or all Lots. For Lots 1, 2 and 3 the successful tenderers may be allocated as preferred supplier for a Geographical Region or Regions on the basis of their tenders and there may be a limit on the number of Regions for which a single supplier achieves preferred supplier status. It is anticipated that Uisce Eireann will enter into separate framework agreements for each of the following Lots: Lot 1 - Potable Water Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require potable water laboratory testing services for the following sampling categories: • PLANNED (Drinking Water Directive – Schedule 1 and Schedule 2) • UNPLANNED (Investigative; Short term requests e.g. EPA) • EMERGENCY. For each of the categories above, Uisce Eireann may require a combination of Sampling and Testing services (i.e. taking the sample, transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting), a Collection and Testing service (i.e. collection of sample(s) from a designated collection point(s), transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting) and Testing Only (receipt of samples delivered to the suppliers laboratory analysis and reporting). With regards to the PLANNED, UNPLANNED, and EMERGENCY categories, Uisce Eireann may also require sampling and/or testing of raw water (i.e. ground water or surface water), and In-Process Water (i.e. samples taken from locations within the treatment process). Additional Services may be procured through the course of the framework to facilitate various investigative activities including but not limited to the following areas of work:- • Process Optimisation • Process Proving / Commissioning These additional services may be PLANNED or UNPLANNED in nature. Lot 2: Provision of Wastewater Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require wastewater laboratory testing services for the following sampling categories: • PLANNED (Wastewater Regulatory Sampling Plans ) • UNPLANNED (Investigative; Short term requests e.g. EPA) • EMERGENCY. For each of the categories above, Uisce Eireann may require a combination of Sampling and Testing services (i.e. taking the sample, transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting), a Collection and Testing service (i.e. collection of sample(s) from a designated collection point(s), transport to the supplier’s laboratory, analysis and reporting) and Testing Only (receipt of samples delivered to the suppliers laboratory analysis and reporting). The applicant should also have the capability to undertake analysis of samples from saline waters. With regards to the PLANNED, UNPLANNED, and EMERGENCY categories, Uisce Eireann may also require sampling and/or testing of In-Process Wastewater (i.e. samples taken from locations within the treatment process). Additional Services may be procured through the course of the framework to facilitate various investigative activities including but not limited to the following areas of work:- • Process Optimisation • Process Proving / Commissioning • Flow and Load Surveys • Sludge Testing These additional services may be PLANNED or UNPLANNED in nature. Lot 3: Provision of Contingency outsourcing of Laboratory Testing Services. Uisce Eireann require the provision of Drinking Water and Wastewater contingency and surge laboratory testing services to maintain continuity during equipment failure, accreditation loss, or capacity constraints.

title: 10021886-Provision of standardised consultancy services for On- & Off-Grid Regulation and Market Development
description: Under the GIZ initiative GET.transform, the contractor will support partner countries and regions in advancing the global energy transition through technical assistance and advisory services. The focus areas are On-Grid Regulation and Market Development and Off- Grid Regulation and Market Development. The contractor will provide expert services, ensure flexibility to adapt to evolving needs, and contribute to achieving the overall programme objectives. GIZ will manage implementation jointly with local partners (worldwide), with English as the main working language, although other languages may be required depending on the project context. Regular coordination formats-such as weekly meetings and interim reports-will be established at the start of the assignment. Specific activities and expert assignments will be defined progressively based on partner requests. Objectives and Expected Results The contractor will strengthen the technical and institutional capacities of partner countries on On- and Off-Grid Regulation and Market Development. These areas represent the essentials to create the regulatory base and needed market mechanisms to transform towards a well-established and framework-based energy transition. 1. On-Grid Regulation and Market Development Objective and Scope The goal is to enable renewable energy participation and investment by developing and re-designing power markets and the reconsideration of traditional business models and power sector regulatory frameworks. Approach Partner countries face diverse challenges on regulatory frameworks and power markets- Support activities may include: - Renewable Energy Procurement and Transaction Advisory: Support governments and public institutions in designing and implementing renewable energy procurement programmes by strengthening policy, regulatory, financial, and governance frameworks. Services include auction and tender design, IPP procurement and transaction advisory, PPA negotiations, risk mitigation strategies, and stakeholder capacity building - Renewable Energy Distributed Generation: Provide advisory services for the development and implementation of market-driven distributed generation frameworks, including the assessment and design of regulatory models. Support policy development, regulatory reforms, programme implementation, and capacity building to accelerate DG deployment. - Power Market Reform: Advise on the design and implementation of power market reforms that improve market efficiency, transparency, and investment attractiveness. Services include tariff and market mechanism design, regional market integration, cross-border trade facilitation, and the development of regulatory frameworks that enable renewable energy integration and private sector participation. 2. Off-Grid Regulation and Market Development Objective and Scope The aim is the development of pathways and plans to extend interconnected distribution grids and isolated mini-grids by addressing implementation issues from a policy and infrastructure perspective. Approach Partner countries face diverse challenges on regulatory frameworks that enable opportunities for electricity access, mini-grid and productive-use projects. Support activities may include: - Electrification Planning and Siting: Support governments in developing integrated electrification plans that identify least-cost electrification pathways through grid extension, mini-grids, and standalone systems. Services include geospatial planning, mini-grid site identification, productive use of energy (PUE) integration, and technical assistance to improve project viability and long-term electrification strategies. - Mini-Grid Frameworks: Develop and implement regulatory, tariff, procurement, and financing frameworks that create an enabling environment for private sector investment in mini-grids. Services include competitive procurement and incentive mechanism design, coordination with financing partners, capacity building, and technical assistance to support sustainable mini-grid market development. - Standalone System Frameworks: Support the development of regulatory and technical frameworks for standalone energy systems that promote market growth while ensuring quality, consumer protection, and regulatory oversight. Services include the design of market rules, technical standards, operational guidelines, and implementation support to enable sustainable standalone energy markets. All interventions will be tailored to each country"s stage in (on- & off-grid) regulation and market development and its broader development objectives. Collaboration and Adaptability The contractor must maintain a flexible and responsive working approach, adapting activities and work plans to changing needs and partner requests. A collaborative management system with GIZ will ensure regular communication, alignment of priorities, and continuous quality assurance. Deliverables Deliverables may include analytical studies, policy and technical recommendations, capacity-building sessions, and communication materials. All outputs will be reviewed and approved by GIZ and its partners before completion. In summary, the contractor will act as a technical partner to GIZ, providing adaptable and high-quality support in on- and off-grid regulation and market development. Through collaborative and capacity-oriented implementation, the work will help partner countries design integrated, sustainable, and low-carbon market reforms and on- and off-grid regulatory frameworks while fostering transparency, knowledge sharing, and long-term national ownership.
